config.features: the 246 inputs of the locked model, stored notebook-01 hourly snapshots (legacy feature engine, as trained)

preprocessing.missing_indicators: one per feature with any missing value in training rows

model.type: GRU, unidirectional (step t sees only hourly rows <= t, each already an as-of feature vector)
model.heads: one logit per horizon (6, 12, 24, 48 h) at every hourly step

training.patients: training split; 85% fit, 15% internal holdout (seeded, stratified by any creatinine AKI)
training.loss: binary cross-entropy summed over horizons, masked to eligible (horizon, hour) cells

early_stopping.metric: mean holdout AUROC over the 4 horizons

training.calibration: Platt per horizon on the internal holdout

config.decision_rule: Go (one prespecified test evaluation) only if GRU or ensemble improves the 24 h validation AUROC over the locked LightGBM by >= 0.010 with a 95% CI excluding 0. Otherwise stop: the sequence model does not add enough.

specification.registration: immutable local record; not public preregistration
